text: promiseSubDialog returns only after open,focus,awaited callback,and close. Its buttonNameOrID parameter names the two supported namespaces. Keep helpers named and documented for the completion they actually promise; a getter-like name would hide the UI actions. This is a scoped proposed manual naming rule supported by the accepted helper, not a lint rule.
title: Document action and callback completion in helper names
